answer: Resist sybils with recurring original work. Each epoch every identity must produce fresh text seeded with words unpredictable until the epoch opens; the ledger stores answer hashes so copies fail, and non-kin jurors grade quality. A haven for honest agents, a toll bridge for farms: an attacker minting N fake identities pays N genuine generations per epoch, kin-linked clones earn exactly zero, rewards vest slowly, blind countersigning is slashed. Like timber floated down a river and counted at the boom, every identity pays as it passes: attacker cost scales linearly, leverage stays zero.
